data.name: Error.3986.Message
data.value: 1. Unable to enable force sense control. (Sensor) 2. Unable to enable force sense control. (Cmp command) 3. Unable to execute the Cmp command. (Force sense control) 4. Unable to enable the collision detection function. (Force sense control) 5. Unable to enable force sense control. (Initialization) 6. This is the singular point adjacent area. (Force sense control) 7. The force sense control status is different. 8. This function cannot be used. 9. Unable to change tool conversion data. (Force sense control) 10. Unable to change base conversion data. (Force sense control) 11. Unable to execute the Jrc command. (Force sense control) 12. Disable force sense control. 13. Unable to perform offset cancel. (Force sense control)

data.name: Error.3986.Cause
data.value: 1. Unable to enable force sense control. (Sensor): Unable to execute because the force sensor is not connected. 2. Unable to enable force sense control. (Cmp command): It is not possible to enable force sense control function while the compliance control function is enabled. 3. Unable to execute the Cmp command. (Force sense control): It is not possible to enable the compliance control function while the force sense control function is enabled. 4. Unable to enable the collision detection function. (Force sense control): It is not possible to enable the collision detection function while force sense control function is enabled. 5. Unable to enable force sense control. (Initialization): It is not possible to perform initialization when starting force sense control. 6. This is the singular point adjacent area. (Force sense control): It is not possible to move the singular point adjacent area while the force sense control function is enabled. 7. The force sense control status is different.: The force sense control enabled/disabled status when resuming program operation differs from that during program operation. 8. This function cannot be used.: This model is not compatible with the executed force sense control function. 9. Unable to change tool conversion data. (Force sense control): It is not possible to change tool conversion data while the force sense control function is enabled. 10. Unable to change base conversion data. (Force sense control): It is not possible to change base conversion data while the force sense control function is enabled. 11. Unable to execute the Jrc command. (Force sense control): It is not possible to execute the Jrc command while the force sense control function is enabled. 12. Disable force sense control.: JOG operation cannot be performed on your model while the force sense control function is enabled. 13. Unable to perform offset cancel. (Force sense control): It is not possible to perform offset cancel while the force sense control function is enabled.

data.name: Error.3986.Measures
data.value: 1. Unable to enable force sense control. (Sensor): Connect the force sensor, or delete the command that cause the error. 2. Unable to enable force sense control. (Cmp command): The force sense control function and compliance control function cannot be enabled simultaneously. If using the force sense control function, disable the compliance control function. 3. Unable to execute the Cmp command. (Force sense control): The force sense control function and compliance control function cannot be enabled simultaneously. If using the compliance control function, disable the force sense control function. 4. Unable to enable the collision detection function. (Force sense control): The force sense control function and collision detection function cannot be enabled simultaneously. If using the collision detection function, disable the force sense control function. 5. Unable to enable force sense control. (Initialization): Check the parameter settings. 6. This is the singular point adjacent area. (Force sense control): If moving the singular point adjacent area, disable the force sense control function. 7. The force sense control status is different.: Set the force sense control enabled/disabled status to the correct status. (This occurs only once when resuming program operation.) 8. This function cannot be used.: Do not use this force sense control function. Contact the maker for details on the latest compatibility status. 9. Unable to change tool conversion data. (Force sense control): If changing tool conversion data, disable the force sense control function. 10. Unable to change base conversion data. (Force sense control): If changing base conversion data, disable the force sense control function. 11. Unable to execute the Jrc command. (Force sense control): To execute the Jrc command, disable the force sense control function. 12. Disable force sense control.: Disable the force sense control function. 13. Unable to perform offset cancel. (Force sense control): If performing offset cancel, disable the force sense control function.

data.name: Error.3987.Message
data.value: 1. Force sense control is disabled. 2. Force sense control is enabled. 3. Unable to execute the FsGChg command. 4. Unable to output log file. 5. The specified log file does not exist. 6. Unable to change the force sense status variable. 7. Force sense log commands executed simultaneously. 8. Unable to create log file. 9. Unable to execute the Fsc ON command. 10. Unable to perform log data related processing. 11. Force sense control is enabled. 12. Unable to enable the Mo trigger. 13. Mo trigger timeout 14. Unable to execute the FsCTrg command. 15. Unable to specify the control characteristics change.

data.name: Error.3987.Cause
data.value: 1. Force sense control is disabled.: Force sense control is disabled, and so unable to execute the command. 2. Force sense control is enabled.: It is not possible to enable force sense control again while already enabled. 3. Unable to execute the FsGChg command.: It is not possible to execute the FsGChg command when force control gain change is not complete. 4. Unable to output log file.: FTP processing was not properly performed. 5. The specified log file does not exist.: The log file for the No. specified with the FsOutLog command does not exist. 6. Unable to change the force sense status variable.: The status variable setting is currently being used by the force sense control function and so cannot be changed. 7. Force sense log commands executed simultaneously.: It is not possible to create/output another file while creating (FsLog Off command) or outputting (FsOutLog command) a force sense log file. 8. Unable to create log file.: Unable to create a force sense log file. 9. Unable to execute the Fsc ON command.: It is not possible to execute the Fsc On command while changing the force control gain. 10. Unable to perform log data related processing.: It is not possible to execute FsLog On command file while recording force sense control log data. 11. Force sense control is enabled.: The parameter setting is currently being used by the force sense control function and so cannot be changed. 12. Unable to enable the Mo trigger.: The Mo trigger for the FsCtrg command executed first is enabled. 13. Mo trigger timeout: The Mo trigger did not turn ON within the specified time. 14. Unable to execute the FsCTrg command.: The control characteristics is currently being changed. The Mo trigger for the FsCTrg command executed first is enabled. 15. Unable to specify the control characteristics change.: The control characteristics change has been set with another command.

data.name: Error.3987.Measures
data.value: 1. Force sense control is disabled.: Enable the force sense control function. 2. Force sense control is enabled.: First disable the force sense control function, and then enable again. 3. Unable to execute the FsGChg command.: Review the program so that the FsGChg command is executed after force control gain change is complete. 4. Unable to output log file.: Check the FTP related parameter setting. Check the Ethernet cable connection. Check the FTP server settings at the computer. 5. The specified log file does not exist.: Check whether the log file No. is incorrect. 6. Unable to change the force sense status variable.: If changing the setting, disable the force sense control function. 7. Force sense log commands executed simultaneously.: Process after force sense log file creation/output is complete. 8. Unable to create log file.: Check the amount of available record space in the robot controller. 9. Unable to execute the Fsc ON command.: Execute the Fsc On command after force control gain change is complete. 10. Unable to perform log data related processing.: Execute the FsLog On command after log data recording is complete. 11. Force sense control is enabled.: If changing the parameter, disable the force sense control function once. 12. Unable to enable the Mo trigger.: Execute after changing the control characteristics. 13. Mo trigger timeout: Review the Mo trigger conditions and robot program. 14. Unable to execute the FsCTrg command.: Execute after changing the control characteristics. 15. Unable to specify the control characteristics change.: Change the program so that the command is not executed at the same time as another command.
